desc: Whether you're packing a 1911, striker-fire, or revolver, this is the right cleaning kit for you. Its virtually indestructible polycarbonate case with patent pending kickstand design flips open to put every tool you'll need to clean your handguns at your fingertips. There's an ergonomic handle for all the brushes and jags. And tools are clearly labeled and snap securely into place - unlike the chaos of other kits.
